label: Classic dad joke
joke: Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field.
note: Pure wordplay — great for showing the 'wordplay' mechanism and split audience fit.

label: Tech in-joke
joke: I switched my whole life to dark mode. My electricity bill didn't change, but my personality finally matches my terminal.
note: Relies on developer culture; should score high for 'Tech crowd', low for 'Corporate all-hands'.

label: Observational
joke: Airport security is the only place where a stranger yells at you for being bad at getting undressed quickly.

label: Self-deprecating one-liner
joke: I told my therapist about my fear of commitment. We're still deciding whether to keep meeting.

label: Deliberately weak (for contrast)
joke: I like pizza. Pizza is good. Do you like pizza too?
note: Intentionally NOT funny — demonstrates the engine scoring something low and explaining why.

label: Anti-joke
joke: Why did the chicken cross the road? To get to the other side.
note: Anti-joke: subverts the expectation of a subversion. Great 'understanding' talking point.
